T: In space, no one can hear you crunch.
D: A spaceship crew is hunted by a deadly creature that boarded with them.
P: Serve the mains at the crew dinner, before Kane starts feeling unwell.
S: Wheat noodles in sesame, soy, black vinegar and chili oil, spring onion
Cold sesame noodles: thin wheat noodles tossed in sesame paste, soy, black vinegar, chilli oil and garlic, cucumber and spring onion on top.
for the cat, or for you

Crisp sharp cheddar crackers cut into little fish shapes, sprinkled with smoked paprika and sea salt, baked golden and served by the handful. Pulse 150g grated sharp cheddar, 60g cold butter, 100g plain flour and a pinch of salt in a food processor until it clumps, adding 1 tbsp cold water. Chill 20 minutes. Roll 4mm thick, cut into small fish shapes and lay on a lined tray. Dust with smoked paprika and sea salt. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crisp. Cool on the tray.
Seeded crackers with lemon cream cheese and a smoked oyster on each
Seeded crackers spread with cream cheese whipped with lemon zest, topped with tinned smoked oysters, cracked pepper and a few chives.
M: Nostromo pork and egg noodle stir-fry
Wok pork, cabbage, carrot and capsicum with egg noodles in oyster sauce
Pork and vegetable stir-fry with noodles: pork strips, cabbage, carrot, capsicum, soy, oyster sauce and ginger in a smoking wok, piled into bowls.
the escape shuttle, just Ripley and Jonesy

Beef mince browned hard with onion, garlic, chilli and cumin, simmered with tomato and kidney beans until thick, with sour cream, cheddar and crusty bread. Brown 800g beef mince hard in a heavy pot in two batches. Add 2 diced onions and 3 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp chilli powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Add 800g crushed tomatoes, a drained 400g tin kidney beans and 250ml beef stock. Simmer 90 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick. Serve with sour cream, grated cheddar and crusty bread.
W: Red velvet cake filled with raspberry jam, cream cheese frosting
Red velvet cake (buttermilk, cocoa, vinegar, red colouring) baked in a dome, filled with raspberry jam that bursts out when cut, cream cheese frosting.
K: Chilled coffee blended with dark chocolate and milk, whipped cream on top

Strong coffee blended with dark chocolate, milk and ice until frothy, poured tall and topped with whipped cream and shaved chocolate. Brew 300ml strong coffee and stir in 80g chopped dark chocolate and 2 tbsp brown sugar until melted, then cool. Blend with 400ml cold milk and 2 cups of ice for 20 seconds until frothy. Pour into 4 tall glasses, top with whipped cream and shave dark chocolate over the top.

steps.text: Cook the noodles, then rinse cold and drain.
Whisk the sesame paste, soy, vinegar, chilli oil and garlic.
Cut the cucumber into matchsticks and slice the spring onion.
Toss the noodles through the dressing and top with cucumber and spring onion.
Whip the cream cheese with the lemon zest.
Spread onto the crackers.
Top each with a smoked oyster, cracked pepper and snipped chives. Serve straight away.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil until golden, then toss with the soy and smoked paprika and cool.
Whip the cream cheese with the lemon zest.
Spread onto the crackers.
Top each with a piece of mushroom, cracked pepper and snipped chives. Serve straight away.

dishes.make_ahead: Slice the pork and vegetables up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; stir-fry just before serving

steps.text: Slice the pork thin and toss with a little of the soy.
Slice the cabbage, carrots and capsicum.
Heat the oil in a wok until smoking and stir-fry the pork until browned.
Add the vegetables and ginger and stir-fry briefly.
Add the noodles, oyster sauce and remaining soy, toss and serve in bowls.

veg.make_ahead: Press and cut the tofu and slice the vegetables up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; stir-fry on the night

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into thin strips and toss with a little of the soy and the cornflour.
Slice the cabbage, carrots and capsicum.
Heat the oil in a wok until smoking and stir-fry the tofu until browned.
Add the vegetables and ginger and stir-fry briefly.
Add the noodles, mushroom stir-fry sauce and remaining soy, toss and serve in bowls.

dishes.make_ahead: Cake up to 1 day, assemble to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170C and grease a heatproof bowl. Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs.
Fold in the flour, cocoa, buttermilk, vinegar and red colouring.
Bake in the bowl until a skewer comes out clean, then cool completely.
Turn out and hollow out the centre. Fill with the raspberry jam.
Beat the cream cheese with the icing sugar and cover the dome in frosting.

dishes.make_ahead: Coffee mix up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Brew the coffee. Stir in most of the chocolate, chopped, and the sugar until melted, then cool.
Blend with the milk and ice until frothy.
Pour into four tall glasses, top with whipped cream and shave the remaining chocolate over.

s.note: Cold sesame noodles with chilli oil and cucumber
s.how: Cook 400g fresh wheat noodles, rinse cold and drain. Whisk 3 tbsp sesame paste, 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp black vinegar, 1 tbsp chilli oil and a crushed garlic clove. Toss through and top with cucumber matchsticks and spring onion.

s.note: Seeded crackers with lemon cream cheese and smoked oysters
s.how: Whip 150g cream cheese with the zest of a lemon. Spread on 16 seeded crackers and top each with a smoked oyster from 2 drained tins. Finish with cracked pepper and snipped chives. Serve straight away.

m.note: Pork and vegetable noodle stir-fry in bowls
m.how: Slice 500g pork shoulder thin and toss with soy. Stir-fry in a smoking wok, then add a quarter cabbage, 2 carrots and 1 capsicum, all sliced, with grated ginger. Add 400g egg noodles, 3 tbsp oyster sauce and 2 tbsp soy, toss and serve in bowls.

w.note: Red velvet dome that bursts with raspberry jam when cut
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 250g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 250ml buttermilk, 1 tsp vinegar and red colouring. Bake in a bowl at 170C for 50 minutes. Hollow, fill with raspberry jam and cover in cream cheese frosting.

d.note: Strong coffee blended with dark chocolate, milk and ice until frothy, poured tall and topped with whipped cream and shaved chocolate.
d.how: Brew 300ml strong coffee and stir in 80g chopped dark chocolate and 2 tbsp brown sugar until melted, then cool. Blend with 400ml cold milk and 2 cups of ice for 20 seconds until frothy. Pour into 4 tall glasses, top with whipped cream and shave dark chocolate over the top.
